headline: Public hearing on Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan covering 40 Sargent Street, 46 Millett Street, 10 Gale Road, 18 Gale Road, and 131R Gloucester Avenue.
summary: The Planning Board will hold a public hearing on Energy North Incorporated's application for the Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan. The board will also review proposed zoning amendments on multi-family dwelling dimensions and the Watershed Protection Overlay District.
items: Forum invitation: "The Power of Arts and Culture Planning," October 6, 2026, 6PM, Kyrouz Auditorium, City Hall

Public hearing on Energy North Incorporated's application for the Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan at 40 Sargent Street, 46 Millett Street, 10 Gale Road, 18 Gale Road, and 131R Gloucester Avenue (Assessor's Map 32, Lots 18 and 22; Map 33, Lot 3; and Map 43, Lots 1 and 2)
Proposed amendment to Section 3.2.2 Dimensional Requirements for Multi-family Dwellings and Their Accessory Uses (other than signs)
Proposed amendments to Section 5.10 Watershed Protection Overlay District
location: Kyrouz Auditorium, City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930
